svg.text: Drag fields between the boxes, or use a chip's ▾ menu.
Fills Report!A5:E11. Its cells can't be typed over.
Pivot 1 · The pivot table and its field panel (Tools ▸ Pivot Table…)
The pivot is an object with a name (SalesPivot) and a place (A5). Its cells belong to it, as a SQL() result's do.
Same field panel as Excel's: tick a field, or drag it between Filters, Columns, Rows and Values.
Every chip has a ▾ menu with Move to…, so nothing needs the mouse (BITV).
It is live: it follows Sales, rows added below the table too. There is no Refresh. SalesPivot is a name, so a chart can read it.
The panel floats over the History & Chat dock, like Search & replace, and can be moved. Esc closes it.
